mechanism: For a fixed strategy lot (FixedLot, typically 0.01), run a long test with large deposit, read max absolute equity drawdown MaxDD, set FittedBalance = MaxDD / 0.10 (target 10% relative DD). Live size is CurrentLot = FixedLot * (DepoPart * TotalBalance / FittedBalance), optionally with FixedBalance locking a constant notional. Same FittedBalance is further scaled when combining StrategiesCount instances: FittedBalance *= StrategiesCount / Scale so a normalized group still targets ~10% joint DD.
data_needed: Backtest STAT_EQUITY_DD (absolute) for each strategy instance; account balance or FixedBalance; DepoPart = expectedDrawdown/10; Scale multiplier from joint group tests
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP, EURUSD, GBPUSD; PERIOD_H1 SimpleVolumesStrategy instances; test windows 2018–2022 shown
why_new_for_mis: Turns historical max equity DD into a portable risk-budget sensor that MIS can use to resize any sleeve so expected relative DD stays on a fixed target across balances and multi-strategy stacks.

mechanism: Normalize each strategy alone to 10% DD, then combine; observed joint DD is usually << 10% when instances are dissimilar, so Scale = 10% / observed_group_DD can inflate sizes. Nested groups (e.g. 3+3+3 by symbol then a top group) apply Scale at each level: FittedBalance = (StrategiesCount1*StrategiesCount2*…) * FittedBalance / (Scale1*Scale2*…). Empirically 3+3+3 beat a flat 9-pack on the same period.
data_needed: Per-group backtest equity DD after combining already-normalized children; chosen nesting by symbol/TF
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP/EURUSD/GBPUSD H1; 3 instances per symbol; Scale examples 1.25 / 2.24 / 2.64 then top Scale≈2.18
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a measurable diversification dividend (joint DD vs sum of solo DDs) as a continuous sensor of how asynchronously risk events hit across sleeves—usable to auto-raise Scale when drawdowns desynchronize.
quote: the fifth option for grouping strategies gives much better results while maintaining the maximum relative drawdown within 10%

idea_name: Tick-volume spike vs rolling average open signal
mechanism: CSimpleVolumesStrategy copies iVolumes(VOLUME_TICK) over signalPeriod bars, averages them (later excluding the forming bar), and fires when current volume > avg * (1 + signalDeviation + ordersTotal * signaAddlDeviation). Direction is buy if iOpen < iClose on the signal bar else sell; pending distance openDistance, SL/TP in points, expiration minutes. Multi-instance packs share this sensor with different periods/deviations.
data_needed: Tick-volume series per symbol/TF; signalPeriod, signalDeviation, signaAddlDeviation; openDistance/stopLevel/takeLevel/ordersExpiration/maxCountOfOrders
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP, EURUSD, GBPUSD on PERIOD_H1 (and later M30/M15 in pipeline); volume checked also with PERIOD_M1 new-bar gating in Part 8
why_new_for_mis: A concrete tick-volume burst sensor relative to a local mean—MIS can stream volume z-score / relative deviation as a liquidity/activity regime channel independent of price.
quote: If the current volume exceeds the specified level… if the opening price of the candle is less than the current (closing) price, then… buy signal

idea_name: Min-max composite quality score for instance ranking
mechanism: From optimization rows min-max scale Profit, Expected Payoff, Profit Factor, Recovery Factor, Sharpe Ratio, Equity DD %, Trades into [0,1]; score = 0.5*Profit_s + ExpectedPayoff_s + ProfitFactor_s + RecoveryFactor_s + SharpeRatio_s + (1−EquityDD_s) + 0.3*Trades_s. Sort descending and hand-pick dissimilar rows (avoid near-identical SL that never hit) so drawdown times differ before grouping.
data_needed: Full optimization metrics table per pass; fittedBalance = relDDpercent * 10000 when initial deposit was 100000
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP H1 SimpleVolumesSingle optimization (~18k rows after dropping negative profit); FixedBalance=10000 baseline group of 16
why_new_for_mis: Provides a transparent multi-metric fitness surface MIS can reuse to rank candidate sensors/sleeves and prefer combinations whose risk peaks are temporally diverse.
quote: 0.5 * Profit_s + ExpectedPayoff_s + ProfitFactor_s + RecoveryFactor_s + SharpeRatio_s + (1 - EquityDD_s) + 0.3 * Trades_s

idea_name: K-means clustering of strategy params to enforce group diversity
mechanism: KMeans(n_clusters=64) on columns signalPeriod_, signalDeviation_, signaAddlDeviation_, openDistance_, stopLevel_, takeLevel_; optionally keep one best Sharpe row per cluster. OptGroupClusterExpert rejects genetic individuals whose selected indices share a cluster so near-duplicate equity paths cannot cohabit a group—raising effective Scale.
data_needed: CSV/DB of first-stage parameter sets; sklearn KMeans labels; uniqueness check on cluster IDs in OnInit
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP H1 Params_SV_EURGBP_H1; groups of up to 8; 2018–2022 genetic opt
why_new_for_mis: Frames parameter-space clustering as a proxy sensor of strategy similarity / coincident-drawdown risk—MIS can cluster sleeve configs and forbid same-cluster co-allocation.
quote: Each cluster will contain sets of parameters that give either completely identical or similar results… launch such a run only if the numbers of all clusters in this group of parameter sets turn out to be different

idea_name: OnTester fittedProfit = profit scaled to 10% DD
mechanism: Custom criterion fittedProfit = profit * (fixedBalance_ * 0.1 / STAT_EQUITY_DD) so each genetic pass reports the profit that would have been earned if position sizes were scaled to hit exactly 10% of FixedBalance drawdown—comparable across groups with different raw DDs.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Same EURGBP H1 group-selection EAs; genetic maximization of fittedProfit
why_new_for_mis: A DD-normalized profit score MIS can apply whenever comparing sensors or sleeves under unequal realized risk—makes cross-regime fitness comparable.
quote: The ratio of possible increase in position sizes for the drawdown of 10% of fixedBalance_… Recalculate the profit… fittedProfit = profit * coeff

idea_name: IS/OOS SumDiff–Res selector for forward-stable groups
mechanism: Join main-period and forward-period opt rows by Pass; correct forward normalized profit by EquityDD_OOS/EquityDD_IS. Compute ratios (ResultRatio with 5× year-length fix, TradesRatio, …) vs unity; SumDiff = Σ|1−ratio_i|; Scale = 10 / MAX(OOS_EquityDD, IS_EquityDD); Res = Scale / SumDiff. Sort by Res and greedily pick groups with disjoint cluster indices—preferring parameter sets whose behavior barely changes across the IS→OOS regime cut.
data_needed: Paired IS and OOS tester stats per parameter set; EquityDD both periods; optional cluster IDs
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP H1 clustered sets; IS 2018–2022, OOS 2023, holdout early 2024; later also IS 2018–2023 vs 2024
why_new_for_mis: Treats the forward boundary as an explicit regime-change probe and scores sleeves by invariance of trading stats across that cut—directly usable as a MIS stability/regime-shift robustness sensor.
quote: Res = Scale / SumDiff… groups, whose results in the main and forward periods were more similar and the drawdown in both periods was smaller, find themselves at the top

mechanism: CNewBarEvent / CSymbolNewBarEvent lazily Register(symbol,timeframe) on first IsNewBar call; UpdateNewBar() once per tick refreshes all tracked iTime(0) flags so every strategy instance sees a consistent new-bar bit. Optional m_useOnlyNewBar short-circuits the whole EA Tick when no tracked bar rolled—aligning OHLC-1m optimization with every-tick live.
data_needed: iTime per (symbol, TF) of interest; call UpdateNewBar at start of advisor Tick
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Benchmark up to 16384 SimpleVolumes instances; M1 gate and H1/D1 examples; EURGBP H1 params file
why_new_for_mis: A reusable multi-asset bar-clock sensor that MIS can subscribe to for synchronized regime updates without each sleeve reinventing last-bar time tracking.
quote: IsNewBar(symbol, timeframe)… if a new bar has arrived on the current tick, and the function is called several times… it should return true on each call

idea_name: Annualized DD-normalized profit frame into SQLite
mechanism: OnTester computes coeff = FixedBalance*0.1/STAT_EQUITY_DD, fittedProfit = profit*coeff*(365*24*3600)/(TimeCurrent−m_fromDate), packs all TesterStatistics plus strategy ~params into a FrameAdd payload; main-terminal OnTesterPass writes rows into SQLite passes. Enables later cross-pass sensing over a durable corpus.
data_needed: TesterStatistics suite; strategy initialization string; SQLite passes table; FrameAdd/FrameNext path for local/cloud agents
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: SimpleVolumesExpertSingle short-period smoke opt; any symbol/TF of the single-instance EA
why_new_for_mis: Persists a time-normalized, DD-normalized fitness per pass so MIS can treat the optimization archive itself as a longitudinal sensor of what worked under which market windows.
quote: Calculate the profit in annual terms… fittedProfit = profit * coeff * 365 * 24 * 3600 / totalSeconds

idea_name: Project–Stage–Job–Task queue as multi-regime opt orchestrator
mechanism: ORM tables project/stage/job/task/pass drive an Optimization.mq5 EA that sequentially launches stage EAs via MTTESTER for each symbol×TF×criterion. Selection later uses Sharpe>5 and custom_ontester filters—but the article itself builds infrastructure, not a market-state sensor.
data_needed: SQLite schema with stages/jobs/tasks; fxsaber MultiTester; stage expert names and date ranges
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP, EURUSD, GBPUSD × H1/M30/M15; 81 tasks example; 2021–2022 universal EA test
why_new_for_mis: No new market sensing idea after full read—pipeline orchestration only.
quote: we want to get an EA that runs in the terminal and performs EA optimization with one instance of a trading strategy on several symbols and timeframes

idea_name: Stage-2 task DB extract filtered by quality gates
mechanism: Before group genetic opt, CreateTaskDB copies from main DB only First-stage passes for idParentJob with custom_ontester>2500, trades>20, sharpe_ratio>2 into a slim tester_file SQLite (params only)—then optimizes combinations of up to 16 indices. Best-per-job groups later assembled via SQL ROW_NUMBER() PARTITION BY id_task.
data_needed: Main DB joins passes/tasks/jobs/stages; quality thresholds; PARAMS_FILE for agents
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: 3 symbols × 3 TFs second-stage jobs; ~2y interval; combined EA of best groups
why_new_for_mis: Codifies quality gates (normalized profit, trade count, Sharpe) as a reusable pre-filter sensor before combinatorial sleeve selection—MIS can apply the same gates when admitting candidates into ensembles.
quote: pass normalized profit exceeds 2500; number of trades exceeds 20; Sharpe ratio is greater than 2

idea_name: Risk-manager overall-profit deadline as soft wind-down sensor
mechanism: Extend CVirtualRiskManager with m_maxOverallProfitDate; OverallProfit() returns current m_overallProfit (forcing flat) once TimeCurrent exceeds the deadline, else the configured money/%-of-base target. Used as trading-completion mode when swapping EA versions without hard-closing underwater books immediately.
data_needed: rmMaxOverallProfitLimit_, rmMaxOverallProfitDate_, base balance, live overallProfit
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Final multi-group SimpleVolumesExpert; broker symbol-replace map; restart Save/Load with MD5 of strategy-group params
why_new_for_mis: A time-bounded profit-target / force-flat sensor MIS can attach to any sleeve lifecycle—soft exit when a regime or deployment window expires.
quote: If the current time is greater than the specified maximum time… Return the value that guarantees the positions are closed

idea_name: Cross-broker tick-volume divergence as quote-feed sensor
mechanism: Same EA that profits on MetaQuotes-Demo tick volumes drains another broker because SignalForOpen keys only on tick-volume spikes (prices affect direction only). Deal-history export + CHistoryStrategy replay on the second server recovers near-original equity—proving price paths are similar but volume histories are not. Implication: treat broker tick-volume series as a first-class, non-portable liquidity feed.
data_needed: Parallel deal lists / history CSV; tick-volume buffers per broker; optional dual-terminal signal vs execution split
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Multi-symbol SimpleVolumesExpert 2021–2022; MetaQuotes-Demo vs real-server quotes; history replay EAs
why_new_for_mis: Shows tick volume can be a broker-specific liquidity sensor whose disagreement across venues is itself a MIS alert—and motivates separating signal generation onto a trusted volume feed.
quote: the issue is precisely in the strong differences in the tick volume values received from different servers… brokers are free to decide how many ticks to store

idea_name: Embedded strategy-groups library without live DB
mechanism: Stage-3 single passes save named groups into strategy_groups; Export writes ENUM_GROUPS_LIBRARY + s_params[] init strings into ExportedGroupsLibrary.mqh so the final EA picks a group by enum without shipping multi-GB SQLite. Engineering packaging, not a market sensor.
data_needed: strategy_groups table; pass params strings; LibraryExport EA
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Previously selected EUR/GBP/USD H1 (and multi-TF) groups; final SimpleVolumesExpert library picker
why_new_for_mis: No MIS sensing idea after full read—deployment packaging of init strings only.
quote: we want to form a library of good initialization strings, from which we can choose one for the current EA launch

idea_name: Euclidean IS–OOS distance on min-max scaled pass metrics
mechanism: With tester forward_mode, store is_forward on each pass; pair IS/OOS by pass number. Min-max scale custom_ontester, equity_dd_relative, profit_factor over the task; dist = Σ(I_metric−O_metric)². Sort ascending to pick groups whose metric vectors barely move across the forward cut (vs best-IS-only). Pre-2015–2017 holdout showed smaller DD blow-up for min-dist pick.
data_needed: passes with is_forward; paired IS/OOS metrics; SQL temp tables t0/t1 as in article
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP H1 stage-2 with forward 2023; compare 2018–2023, 2024, and 2015–2017
why_new_for_mis: A concrete metric-space regime-stability sensor: distance between in-sample and out-of-sample performance vectors flags sleeves likely to survive the next regime shift.
quote: calculate the usual Euclidean distance between two result vectors, for which we will first apply min-max scaling

idea_name: Python KMeans on pass statistics then one champion per cluster
mechanism: Optimization stage runs ClusteringStage1.py via ShellExecute: load profitable First-stage passes (filters on custom_ontester/trades/sharpe), KMeans on selected stats columns (profit, trades, DD, PF, …), keep argmax custom_ontester per cluster into passes_clusters. Stage-2 optionally JOINs that table so genetic group search only sees diverse champions—empirically lifted GBPUSD H1 normalized annual profit vs unclustered stage-2.
data_needed: SQLite passes; argparse db_path/id_task/n_clusters; passes_clusters(id_task,id_pass,cluster); Stage2 useClusters_ flag
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURGBP H1 and GBPUSD H1; 2018–2023; 256 clusters example; joint best groups ~USD 4900 normalized annual
why_new_for_mis: Clusters the performance-feature space of candidate sensors/sleeves and admits one exemplar each—MIS can use the same pattern to diversify an ensemble without redundant coincident-risk members.
quote: divided all the instances into a relatively small number of clusters and took only one instance from each cluster… results either did not deteriorate or became significantly better
